opennyai_summary.17_January_2023__facts:
This application has been filed with a prayer to release the accused applicant on bail in Case Crime No.108 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 304-B I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kuthaund, District Jalaun.
He himself admitted the deceased in the hospital.
Till date, no statement of any witness has been recorded before the trial court.
The accused applicant is in jail since 05.06.2020,
hence the applicant should be released on bail.
opennyai_summary.17_January_2023__arguments:
Learned counsel for the accused applicant has submitted that the accused applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the crime.
Applicant is the husband of the deceased.
He is not responsible in any manner for the death of the deceased.
No allegation of demand of dowry against him has been made.
The cause of death is ante-mortem injuries which were found on the body of the deceased.
In the opinion of the doctor conducting post mortem, it is a suspected case of smothering.
Therefore, the accused applicant should not be enlarged on bail.
opennyai_summary.17_January_2023__ANALYSIS:
It transpires from the record that as per the version of the F.I.R., there is allegation of demand of dowry and the deceased died an unnatural death.
The post mortem report reveals that the injury has been found on the person of the deceased and in the opinion of the doctor, the cause of death is suspected smothering.
opennyai_summary.17_January_2023__decision: The prayer for bail is declined and the bail application of applicant- Sandeep is rejected.
